INITIATE PULL 2/6

Pause
Normal
PRIMARY
Lats
SECONDARY
Rhomboids, Rear Deltoids, Biceps

Instructions

Preparation: Hinge at the hips with soft knees and a neutral back. Hold the bar overhand outside the knees, with plates clear of the floor.

1

Hinge steady; arms hang below shoulders.

2

Bend elbows; keep both wrists straight.

3

Drive elbows back beside the torso.

4

Bring the bar to lower ribs.

5

Lower smoothly; maintain the hip hinge.

6

Arms extend; plates stay off floor.

Watch out

If your torso keeps rising to yank the bar up, you're cheating with leg drive. Lock the hinge or drop weight — standing reps train traps, not lats.

COMMON MISTAKES

Standing up through the pull so the torso angle changes rep to rep.
Rounding the lower back to reach the bar at the bottom.
Yanking with the arms before the shoulder blades have started to pull.
